subject: Proposal: volume ladder and rate lane realignment for Streamline AI
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Li <megan.li@streamline.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: volume ladder and rate lane realignment for Streamline AI

Hi Megan —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Based on Streamline's growth pattern and your forecast, we put together a compact proposal to align monthly commits, adjust usage tiers, and introduce a volume ladder that reduces unit price as you cross the top bands. High-level summary: 

- Monthly commit: move from 750M -> 1.5B tokens/month (6-mo ramp)
- Rate bands: introduce a 3-tier ladder with stepped discounts at 1B and 3B monthly consumption
- Soft-burst: +20% burst for peak sale days with usage smoothing to avoid throttles
- Onboarding: 4-week ops plan (CS-led) with a dedicated throughput validation window

Attached: SOW_Streamline_v2.pdf (SOW + mutual action plan) and a preliminary pricing_worksheet_streamline.xlsx.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Quick sync with your procurement (Tim) to confirm PO timing
2) Karthik to run a short throughput sim to validate rate bands and expected p50/p95 latencies
3) Legal to review attached SOW and propose execution path (DocuSign link to follow)

If that works, can we lock a 30-minute time slot next Tue or Wed?

Best,

Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
[Attachment: SOW_Streamline_v2.pdf]
[Attachment: pricing_worksheet_streamline.xlsx]

From: Megan Li <megan.li@streamline.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tim Andrews <tim.procurement@streamline.ai>
Date: 2026-10-08T11:01:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: volume ladder and rate lane realignment for Streamline AI

Hi Irene —

Thanks for the clear summary. A few quick items from our side: 

- The 1.5B commit sounds reasonable, but can you confirm the per-token price for the 3B+ tier? Our CFO will want line-item clarity.
- Tim (cc) owns procurement timing — our quarter closes 10/31 so ideally we can sign before month-end. If not, we may kick off the onboarding work in November and invoice in December.
- We also need to confirm data retention and audit log availability for the higher tier (compliance ask) — can you confirm retention window and access to request logs?

Can Karthik share the expected p95 latency for the proposed commit profile? If we can validate performance under load, we can accelerate internal approvals.

Thanks — happy to take a 30-min sync Tue 10/13 at 10am PT if that works for your team.

—Megan
Megan Li
CTO, Streamline AI
megan.li@streamline.ai
[Sent from mobile]

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Li <megan.li@streamline.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-09T08:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: volume ladder and rate lane realignment for Streamline AI

Hi Megan —

Thanks for the quick reply and the timeline context. Short answers: 

- Audit logs & retention: we support configurable retention up to 90 days in the hosted plan; we can enable longer retention with Private or a retention add-on. I included a short onboarding timeline that shows where log exports and KMS options are configured. See attached onboarding_timeline_v1.pdf.
- For compliance evidence, we can provide SOC 2 artefact references and an export of request logs during the validation window.
- For the 3B+ tier latency: Karthik, can you share a simulated p50/p95 for the 1.5B commit with 20% burst please?

If Streamline signs before 10/31 we'll prioritize the intake and aim to complete the validation by mid-November so you can start traffic ramp without hiccups.

Irene — I'll prepare the onboarding milestones (kickoff, validation, go-live) and include the CS runbook we use for high-throughput customers.

Cheers,

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
[Attachment: onboarding_timeline_v1.pdf]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Li <megan.li@streamline.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-09T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: volume ladder and rate lane realignment for Streamline AI

Hi all —

I ran a short throughput simulation against a 1.5B commit profile with a 20% burst envelope. Key numbers (simulated):

- p50 token latency: 40ms (hosted inference, eu-west model variant)
- p95 token latency: 120ms (spikes during synthetic bursts)
- KV cache hit rate (typical route): ~84% — this is where we get most of the cost efficiency
- Expected peak QPS during your highest campaigns: ~2.8k rps (based on your forecast sheet)

Recommendations: 
- Keep the 20% soft-burst but add a smoothing policy: queue windows of 60s for non-critical background tasks to protect p95 for live user traffic.
- If p95 must be under 100ms consistently, we should pair the commit uplift with a short Dedicated pilot (2–4 GPUs) for the first 6 weeks. That will reduce p95 by ~30–40ms in our tests.

I attached the throughput_simulation.csv with the sample traffic profile and latency buckets. Happy to walk through the file on our call.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
[Attachment: throughput_simulation.csv]

From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Megan Li <megan.li@streamline.ai>, Tim Andrews <tim.procurement@streamline.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-12T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: volume ladder and rate lane realignment for Streamline AI

Thanks everyone — quick confirmation and next steps so we have alignment before the 10/31 internal close: 

1) Commercial: Redwood sends an updated pricing worksheet reflecting the stepped per-token rates at 1B and 3B thresholds. (Attached earlier; we will post a cleaned worksheet to HubSpot and DocuSign).
2) Legal & Procurement: Tim, if you can confirm PO timing, we'll route the SOW for signature. DocuSign link: https://app.redwood.ai/docusign/DS-998312
3) Technical: Karthik will run a short Dedicated pilot proposal if p95 constraints require it; otherwise we'll proceed on Hosted with the smoothing policy enabled.
4) Onboarding: Vanessa will kick off the CS runbook once SOW is executed; target validation window Nov 9–20.

If that sequence works for you, I'll: 
- Post the final pricing worksheet to HubSpot and share the DocuSign packet by EOD 10/13.
- Schedule the Tue 10/13 10am PT call with all stakeholders (calendar invite to follow).

Appreciate the fast turnaround — excited to scale with Streamline.

Best,

Irene Choi
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.ai
[Attachment: SOW_Streamline_v2.pdf (updated)]
